active.title: A personal blog
active.description: Operator words: "I also want another session called blog. Where I'll write some articles."; "We need 3 parts, we have my resume, we have my personal projects, and we will have my personal blog". Rulings: posts are Markdown in this repo, one folder per post (text, images, moving images); the build writes real HTML per post and per project page with title, description and share image, plus an RSS feed ("Markdown in repo, static HTML"); one language per post, chosen by the author, listed in every locale with a language tag ("One per post, your choice"); v1 = index, post page, tags, RSS; the Blog nav item appears once the first post exists. Target: the candidate after resume-refinement.
